115-H. Disqualification for members.—

—   The provisions of section 10 of the Act 
shall,   mutatis mutandis,   apply to the members of the Taluka Panchayat subject, however, 
that the expression ‘Panchayat’ wherever it appears in that section, shall be construed as a 
reference to “Taluka Panchayat”.
